method: Playwright keyboard walkthroughs, accessibility-tree snapshots, live-region recorders, computed contrast, axe-core in dark/HC/125% modes, reflow and text-spacing scripts, Flesch-Kincaid; production build via next start -p 3102 on 2026-11-18

findings.title: Focus falls to <body> after following an in-page link; next Tab jumps to the footer
findings.evidence: Measured (Playwright, keyboard only, 1280x800): after Enter on a link inside main, document.activeElement is BODY; the first Tab focuses the footer link "Malaysia Airports home" and scrolls to scrollY=997. Reproduced on 3 navigations. Links in persistent nav keep focus on the link. Integration notes issue 2 understates this.
findings.expected: On pathname change, focus moves to the new page h1 (tabindex=-1) or main, so Tab continues from the top of the new content.
findings.suggested_fix: Shell effect keyed on pathname (not query) that focuses main h1; keep the route announcer; add an e2e test asserting document.activeElement after navigation.

findings.title: Airport switcher visible label "KUL" is not part of its accessible name
findings.evidence: Measured: axe label-content-name-mismatch (experimental rule, not run by the suite) flags 1 node on /en/kul/flights, /kul/map, /kul/shop-dine, /kul/parking, /guides/departing, /concierge in light, dark, light HC, dark HC and 125%. Visible text "KUL" or "KUL T1 TERMINAL 1"; aria-label "Change airport. Currently KLIA Terminal 1".
findings.expected: The accessible name starts with the visible text so speech-input users can say "click KUL".
findings.suggested_fix: Name it "KUL, KLIA Terminal 1: change airport" or remove aria-label and add visually hidden text after the visible code.

findings.title: Delayed and cancelled board times rely on strikethrough to show which time is old
findings.evidence: Measured (accessibility tree): the time cell for a delayed flight is 17:25 18:20, exposed as cell "17:25 19:10" with no "scheduled" or "estimated" word; most screen readers do not announce . Same pattern in the phone list and saved-flight card. Flight detail page is correct (dl with Scheduled/Estimated).
findings.expected: Programmatic text such as "Scheduled 17:25, now 18:20" and "Cancelled, was 17:25".
findings.suggested_fix: Add visually hidden labels around the two times (keep the visual strikethrough), reusing the Scheduled/Estimated strings from the flight page.

findings.title: Search palette active option is marked only by a 1.03:1 to 1.22:1 tint
findings.evidence: Measured (computed colours): aria-selected option background #e7e8f4 vs #ffffff = 1.22:1 (light and light HC); #20245a vs #1f2350 = 1.03:1 (dark). No outline, bar or icon; DOM focus stays in the combobox (aria-activedescendant). Screenshot reviewed: in dark mode the active row is barely distinguishable.
findings.expected: The active option differs from its neighbours by at least 3:1 (e.g. focus-colour outline or a left bar).
findings.suggested_fix: Add aria-selected:outline-2 aria-selected:outline-focus (or a 4 px inset left border in the focus colour) alongside bg-primary-soft.

findings.title: Single-key "/" shortcut cannot be turned off or remapped
findings.evidence: Measured: with focus on body or a link, pressing "/" opens the Search dialog; inside a text field it types "/" (correct). Display settings offers theme, text size, high contrast and reduce motion only. Level A failure, rated medium because the effect is a dismissible dialog.
findings.expected: A setting to turn single-character shortcuts off, or only modifier shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+K).
findings.suggested_fix: Add a "Keyboard shortcuts" switch (default on) to Display settings and check it in the global key handler, or drop "/" and keep Ctrl/Cmd+K.

findings.title: Live board auto-updates every 30 seconds with no pause or frequency control
findings.evidence: Measured (80 s recording, flight link focused): rows dropped from 63 to 61 and the "Updated" time changed; focus stayed on the same link and the page scrolled 90 px to keep it in place; 1 live-region change (aria-live=off). No control to pause or slow updates. Rated medium because updates are silent and keep focus.
findings.expected: A mechanism to pause, stop or set the frequency of auto-updating content presented alongside other content.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a "Pause live updates" toggle beside "Refreshes every 30 seconds"; pause while a row has focus or hover.

findings.title: Focus ring is invisible on the yellow demo-data banner in dark themes
findings.url: http://localhost:3102/en/kul/flights (dark theme, Tab to "About this prototype" in the banner)
findings.evidence: Measured: outline #ff9fdc on banner #ffc233 = 1.16:1 (dark); #ffc2e9 on #ffc233 = 1.09:1 (dark high contrast). Light 4.29:1, light HC 5.87:1. Screenshot reviewed. Rated medium: one link per page.
findings.expected: Focus indicator at least 3:1 against the banner colour in every theme.
findings.suggested_fix: Override --color-focus inside the banner (use the light-theme #a6157f or the ink colour).

findings.title: Large text sizes clip content and add sideways scrolling on narrow screens
findings.evidence: Measured: home network cards clip content by 34 to 55 px (overflow hidden on a 128 px card; IATA badges mostly cut off, screenshot reviewed); header "Choose airport" label spills out of its button; /en/kul/transport scrolls 30 px and /en/help 15 px sideways. At default text the badges are clipped by 8 to 12 px at 320x256, and at 200% text-only zoom on desktop.
findings.expected: No clipped text and no page-level horizontal scroll at 320 px with any in-app text size.
findings.suggested_fix: Let card title and badge wrap (flex-wrap, min-width 0, no overflow hidden on text), let the header label wrap or collapse to an icon with a name, overflow-wrap:anywhere on long strings.

findings.title: Sticky header and bottom bar cover half the viewport at 400% zoom
findings.evidence: Measured: sticky header 68 px plus fixed bottom bar 57 px = 125 of 256 px; 131 px left for content. No content lost and 0 focus stops fully hidden (2.4.11 passes), so advisory.
findings.expected: More reading room at very small viewport heights.
findings.suggested_fix: Un-stick the header (or hide on scroll down) below about 400 px viewport height.

findings.title: Transport page: an h3 precedes its section h2 in source order
findings.evidence: Measured: in the region labelled "Not covered here yet", h3 "Driving yourself" comes before h2 "Not covered here yet" in the DOM (both at y=3036).
findings.expected: Section heading first in source order.
findings.suggested_fix: Reorder the markup (use CSS grid order for the visual layout if needed).

findings.title: Search palette text field has no visible focus ring
findings.evidence: Measured: the combobox has outline none and no wrapper ring; only the caret shows focus (home and board search fields do show a wrapper ring). Screenshot reviewed.
findings.expected: A visible ring consistent with other search fields.
findings.suggested_fix: Add has-[:focus-visible]:focus-ring (or focus-within ring) to the palette input wrapper.

findings.title: English source titles on Malay pages lack lang="en"
findings.evidence: Measured (text scan): 6 English-language source titles on /ms/kul/parking and 1 on /ms/guides/departing sit inside lang="ms" with no lang override, e.g. "RM2,084 to park at KLIA: if you are going to park long term...". English pages mark Malay correctly.
findings.expected: Text in another language carries its own lang attribute.
findings.suggested_fix: Render source titles with lang from the source record (default en).

findings.title: Immigration and customs guide reads at grade 11
findings.evidence: Measured (Flesch-Kincaid on main text): grade 11.3, reading ease 40, 20 sentences over 25 words; other guides grade 7.5 to 8.7, ease 56 to 64.
findings.expected: Plain language near grade 8 for travel guidance (3.1.5 AAA, advisory).
findings.suggested_fix: Split long sentences, lead with the action, move dated reporting into source notes.

findings.title: Concierge question field drops below the fold after an answer while keeping focus
findings.evidence: Measured (1280x800): after one answer the focused field moved from y=534 to y=1027, outside the viewport.
findings.expected: The focused composer stays visible after each answer.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the composer sticky or call scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"}) on the field after rendering an answer.

findings.title: Board changes are never announced, even for a saved flight
findings.evidence: Measured: over 80 s the only live-region change was the aria-live=off timestamp. The build spec asks for polite board-update announcements; a screen-reader user watching their own flight learns of a gate or time change only by re-reading.
findings.expected: One polite announcement when a saved flight changes status, gate or time.
findings.suggested_fix: Diff saved flights on refresh and post a single polite message.
